body:
she FINALLY played it live 😭

more than a year after The Life of a Showgirl, Taylor gave "The Fate of Ophelia" its first-ever live performance — closing the Academy Museum Gala in LA on Oct. 17 with a four-song set.

"this song, which we are playing for the very first time to you beautiful people, is called 'The Fate of Ophelia,'" she told the room. she opened on "Blank Space" and worked in "Love Story" and "I Knew It, I Knew You" too — her band and backup singers behind her, in a custom Dior gown with a crystal bow.

Conan O'Brien, her "Toy Story 5" castmate, brought her out as "John, Paul, George and Ringo all in one." honestly? accurate.

the whole night is on the site 🤍
